Synopsis:
Dialog with Jannath, where the player can learn more about what happened to Oskar after he left the Zhent camp, how they got married and suddenly he started acting weird. She will ask help from players to stop the possession and will point players towards the atelier for clues.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_OskarsBeloved_Jannath.json: Jannath is Oskar’s wife and is distraught over changes in him after he left the Zhent camp and they married; she believes he’s been taken over by a possession and asks the player to help free him. She directs the player to investigate an atelier for clues about what changed in Oskar. The city around them is tense — recent Iron Throne/Foundry experiments, a neural switchboard and active Steel Watchers, plus Zhentarim activity — any of which could be tied to strange behaviour or mind‑control. Jannath speaks bluntly and can come across as commanding; the player may push back at being ordered (as in the sample exchange).
- LOW_OskarsBeloved_TarhunMnemonis.json: Dialog that triggers when players get close to Jannath's house and get stopped by Tarhun, the butler. They can request access to the house claiming to be adventurers able to help with Oskar's problem.
- LOW_OskarsBeloved_OskarDispeledEvil.json: Players have just casted Dispel Evil and Good: Break Enchantment on Oskar, and for a shot while he is free from the effects of the possession, although the source of the evil that haunts him is not destroyed. He will give some information to players pointing to his previous actions before the possession, variously Mystic Carrion, the atelier, and the cursed paint. His words are hoarse and laboured - the ghost possessing him has been screaming and shouting. If Jannath is present she will interject at the beginning
- CAMP_Karlach_CRD_PaladinsOfTyrAndEngine.json: If players didn't finish Paladins of Tyr nor don't know about Karlach's infernal engine she will remind them about that. If they decide to continue without helping her she permanently leaves the party.
- LOW_OskarsBeloved_AD_NoblesGossiping.json: Two nobles discussing the latest scandal concerning Jannath and Oskar while at an event thrown Jannath herself. This dialog happens only if oskar has not been rescued from the zhent camp, therefore the haunt is not happening.There are a couple references to other elements in the mansion, mainly the lobster tails, which the cooking staff have spit on and a masterpiece painting that is kept in the atelier.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Lady Jannath: If you don't wish to help, leave. (node 17)
- Player: I'm not one of your servants. You can't order me around. (node 225)

context: Jannath is Oskar’s wife and is distraught because he changed after leaving the Zhent camp and marrying her; she believes he’s been taken over by a possession and asks the player to help free him. She will point the player toward Oskar’s atelier for clues — possible leads include his dealings with Mystic Carrion, a cursed paint, and a masterpiece kept there; if players cast Dispel Evil and Good: Break Enchantment, Oskar briefly clears and offers hoarse, labored hints while Jannath may interject. The city and mansion are tense—recent Iron Throne/Foundry experiments, a neural switchboard, active Steel Watchers, and Zhentarim activity could be tied to or complicate his condition. Jannath speaks bluntly and can come across as commanding (the player may push back at being ordered), and approaching the house can bring Tarhun the butler who may block access.
